title: Puzzle footer
description: A framed footer: a hairline box inset from the page edge with dark corner brackets, a brand column (green-tiled wordmark, tagline, square ink social buttons) beside three link columns split by vertical hairlines, each holding one or two groups with a grey label; a bottom bar carries the copyright and legal links in grey. On phones the groups fold into uppercase accordion rows with chevrons.
notes: the phone accordions are native <details>; no JavaScript
